provenance.method: Generated with the shared server exhibition engine and independently checked against the live free API.
provenance.storage: Checked-in static publication containing the complete result, replay frames and catalog snapshot.
provenance.boundary: A published exhibition, separate from browser-local league standings. No payment, wager, prize, wallet signature or commissioned receipt.
provenance.hashMethod: SHA-256 of the match object serialized with recursively sorted object keys; array order is preserved.

catalog.description: A separate 12v12 exhibition using Nouns Nation gangs and roles. Gangs are cosmetic; roster and tactics change play. No season progression, terrain powers, wagers or prizes.

tactics.name: Rush
tactics.description: Close the gap faster and pressure the nearest opponent.

tactics.name: Guard
tactics.description: Advance more slowly; incoming hits deal two less damage, with a minimum of one. Flank bypasses this protection.

tactics.name: Flank
tactics.description: Spread out and prefer exposed healers and slingers. Flanking hits bypass Guard and gain four damage against it; a direct rush can punish the spread.

catalog.resolution: Elimination ends a match. At the time limit, compare survivors, then the sum of each survivor’s remaining health percentage. Equal scores are a draw.
catalog.replay: Position and health samples every four ticks, including the first and final tick. The event feed is capped; frames still contain every unit. Each unit uses its own seeded random stream.
